title: Rehearsals at the family house on Claiborne
summary: Father and brother Sidney held rehearsals at the house on Claiborne near St. Philip.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I wondered, did the fellas ever come to your house?

Oh, yeah. My daddy used to have rehearsals at the house. You didn't have any rehearsals? He used to have rehearsals in the yard. Even my brother Sidney had more than my daddy, see, because my daddy was already organized. He was playing out with big bands and they'd have rehearsals in the other place. But my brother was starting off and they used to have all their rehearsals at the house. We were living at the time right here on Claiborne between St. Philip and Oyser Line, down the back of town side of Bangor, right near St. Philip.
Not far from here, right out here on Claiborne Street.
